svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend one tube to a D: two posts 70 mm tall and a grip bar.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spreader handle: posts 130 mm apart (drawn). Cutter: 110 mm apart.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld an M12 threaded plug into each post foot, faced flat.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: M12 cap screw up through the plate's 13.6 mm hole into

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: each plug, with a spring washer under the head.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lift the finished tool by it; no movement at the feet.
